fieldNotes.truckGate: Decorative black ornamental steel perimeter fence runs the full north/NE public-facing edge (verified in 2023-06 Street View), but the working truck entrances off the internal industrial-park drives (west drive and SW front loop) are open paved aprons with no barrier arm or sliding gate. Controlled-perimeter feel without an actual checkpoint at the truck lanes; classed truckGate=false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at any truck entrance in 2012/2023/2024 Street View or satellite. Listed uncertain only because fence implies some access control.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate from z20 overhead — north face shows a continuous dock bank with ~11 trailers backed in plus open positions; banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large open paved maneuvering/drop yard north of the dock face, fenced, holds parked trailers separate from active dock apron.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide open paved entrances and yard apron; ample room to add a marked express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside Kenosha city industrial park, dense residential immediately south across 52nd St; classed Urban.
